overview: Armor covers 6 body slots — Head, Face, Torso, Legs, Hands and Feet — and its core attributes are Max HP, Damage Reduction, Pollution Resistance and Psi Intensity, on top of a Durability stat that depletes as you take damage (an armor piece breaks and becomes unusable at 0 Durability, though it can be repaired). Wearing multiple pieces from the same named Armor Set grants stacking set bonuses at 2/4/6-piece thresholds that differ per set. Once Human's full armor catalog spans 159 pieces across 20 named sets (per oncehumandb.com).

attributes.name: Max HP
attributes.description: Flat or percentage increase to maximum health; scales with rarity and using higher-rarity hides as crafting materials.

attributes.name: Damage Reduction
attributes.description: Percentage reduction to incoming damage; also scales with hide rarity used in crafting.

attributes.name: Pollution Resistance
attributes.description: Reduces the rate you accumulate Pollution/Mental Pollution in irradiated or RaidZone areas.

attributes.name: Psi Intensity
attributes.description: Boosts status-effect (Frost/Burn/Shock etc.) potency for the wearer.

attributes.name: Durability
attributes.description: Depletes as the piece absorbs damage; upgradeable via the Gear Workbench: Customization tech node for +30% Max Durability. Reaches 0 → the piece breaks until repaired.

craftingNote: Armor is crafted at the same Gear Workbench tiers as weapons (see the Stations section) using hides, fabrics and other materials — higher-rarity hides yield better HP/Damage Reduction rolls on the finished piece.

sets.name: Bastille Set
sets.bonus: +10% Weapon DMG while HP is above 70%, +15% Reload Efficiency. Crouching for 0.5s enters a Bastille state for +40% Weapon DMG, at the cost of disabled sprint and doubled stamina cost for 3s after leaving it. The 4-piece bonus stacks Armor after exiting Bastille (1/sec, up to 60), each stack converting to a 1% max-HP shield on re-entering Bastille.

sets.name: Heavy Duty Set
sets.bonus: +10% Max HP, +8% Elemental DMG. Kills grant +20% Movement Speed for 2s and +40% Elemental DMG that decays over 8s.

sets.name: Lonewolf Set
sets.bonus: Every 2 crits stack 'Lone Shadow' (+6% Crit DMG per stack, up to 10 stacks = +60% Crit DMG). Landing a kill grants +8% Crit Rate for 2 seconds.

sets.name: Renegade Set
sets.bonus: Hitting the same enemy repeatedly stacks 'Archer's Focus' (+4% Weakspot DMG per stack, up to 10). Reloading refunds 0.6% of the magazine per percentage of weakspot hits from the previous magazine, up to +30%.

sets.name: Savior Set
sets.bonus: Reduces Activator/medicine cooldowns; at 3 pieces, automatically uses an Activator when needed; at 4 pieces, gains increased agility and defense after using an Activator.

sets.name: Stormweaver Set
sets.bonus: Taking damage builds 'Powered Armor' stacks (+4% DMG Reduction each, up to 6 = 24%); rolling consumes 3 stacks to trigger an explosion that knocks back nearby enemies and heals you.
sets.playstyle: Damage mitigation with an offensive panic button.

sets.name: Blackstone Set (Cold)
sets.notes: Cold-region variant of the Blackstone Set.

sets.name: Blackstone Set (Heat)
sets.notes: Heat-region variant of the Blackstone Set.

sets.name: Gravity Tide Set
sets.notes: Tied to the Gravity Abyss season (patch 2.4.1).

note: The full bonus text for the last 14 sets above wasn't confirmed by the sources used to compile this database — piece count and rarity are confirmed (per oncehumandb.com), but check oncehumandb.com/armor-sets or the in-game Codex for their exact set-bonus wording.
